## Constraints

### Must

- Masayume markup and classes stay exact where they exist (D-081); new state and flagged surfaces only
- Tokens only: no hex or px in TSX (design-literals invariant); values live in feature CSS
- Vermilion is the only accent; sentiment uses --profit/--loss
- Dark and light themes from the same rules
- Money in integer base units

### Avoid

- images, gradients, heavy card shadows on the wire
- Tailwind colour utilities in final code
- a second accent colour
- copying HTML drafts verbatim
